clue.text: Old convicts took steps to make it work

definitions.text: Old convicts took steps to make it work

parts.words: Old convicts took steps to make it work
parts.note: Victorian prisoners were punished by walking a wheel of steps that turned machinery, so their steps literally drove it

explanation.surface: A historical note about prison labour.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheel turned by prisoners stepping on its paddles was a Victorian prison punishment.

clue.text: Storm out of gear

indicators.note: the letters of the word gear come out of their order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone flounces off after a mechanical failure.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm is to rant furiously, a synonym in its verb sense.

clue.text: Moderately slowly and before in time

parts.note: ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: A tempo marking explained in musical terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in time' is a link that keeps the musical picture going.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian tempo marking for a moderately slow, walking pace.

clue.text: Complain about fashionable but topless hairstyle

indicators.note: the complaint wraps round the trimmed word, as one thing goes about another

parts.note: to moan is to complain

indicators.note: a word with its top, in a down clue its first letter, removed

parts.note: chic means fashionable

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles over a trendy haircut missing its top.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue the top of a word is its first letter, so 'topless' drops it; 'but' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A haircut with a single central strip and shaved sides, named after a Native American people.

clue.text: Went before a queen of Sparta

parts.note: led is the past tense of lead, to go in front

explanation.surface: A precedence question in ancient Greek royalty.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she was the Spartan queen seduced by Zeus as a swan.

clue.text: Would she be well-advised to do her shopping in the basement?

definitions.text: Would she be well-advised to do her shopping in the basement?

parts.words: Would she be well-advised to do her shopping in the basement?
parts.note: a bargain basement is the cheap floor of a department store, the natural haunt of someone after a cheap deal

explanation.surface: Advice to a thrifty shopper about which floor to visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone always seeking cut-price deals would head for the discounted bargain basement.

clue.text: Fourth officer

parts.note: read as a quarter (a fourth) plus a master (an officer), this names a single rank

explanation.surface: A ship's pecking order.
explanation.definitionFit: An officer responsible for supplies and quarters; literally a quarter plus a master.

clue.text: Indulged in publicity-played in the band?

definitions.meaning: literally beat the percussion in a group

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for vigorous promotion is literally what a drummer does in a band.

clue.text: Formalised version of the catechism

indicators.note: a version is a reworked form, so the letters of catechism are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dry rewrite of religious instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Schematic means simplified into a formal diagram or system.

clue.text: Express with no restaurant car?

parts.note: fasting means going without food, so a train lacking a dining car might be said to be fasting

explanation.surface: A complaint about catering on a rapid service.
explanation.definitionFit: An express is a quick train; to fast is also to go without food.

clue.text: Arrangement of bars in which a singer might be confined

definitions.text: in which a singer might be confined
definitions.meaning: a songbird such as a canary is kept in one

explanation.definitionFit: A barred enclosure, the sort used to keep a pet songbird.

clue.text: Criticise in an attempt to gain access

definitions.meaning: to run something down in conversation
a rap on a door asking to be let in

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for disparaging, and the rap at a door requesting entry.

clue.text: Topless girl's operatic song

indicators.note: the girl's name loses its first letter

parts.note: Maria is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A risqué moment on the opera stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A solo vocal piece in an opera.

clue.text: Hot food even if not heated

definitions.text: Hot food even if not heated

parts.words: Hot food even if not heated
parts.note: hot here means spicy, so the dish stays fiery even served cold

explanation.surface: A remark about a dish that burns even when cold.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiced Indian-style dish whose heat comes from chilli, not temperature.

clue.text: A leg I twisted being nimble

indicators.note: the letters of a leg I are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: An athlete twists a leg yet stays light on their feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Agile and nimble are synonyms for quick, light movement.

clue.text: He has a refined taste for cooked pie, the French priest

indicators.note: cooking changes the form of the pie, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: a curé is a French parish priest

explanation.surface: A French cleric enjoys a well-made pie.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourmet, someone devoted to fine food and drink.

clue.text: You would not care to be guilty of it

definitions.text: You would not care to be guilty of it

parts.words: You would not care to be guilty of it
parts.note: read literally, the fault consists of not caring, i.e. failing to look after something

explanation.surface: A moral warning about an undesirable fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Failure to give proper care or attention.

clue.text: Eager with a desire for drink

explanation.definitionFit: An old word meaning thirsty, and figuratively longing for something.

clue.text: The reason he left crime

indicators.note: the word he has left, so it is removed

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone explains why a man committed an offence.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing HE from THEREASON leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying one's country is a serious crime.

clue.text: Starch found on bird heard by the sea in France

indicators.note: the parrot's name is spoken and its sound written down

parts.note: Polly is the stock name for a parrot
mer is French for sea

explanation.surface: A seabird found on a French beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Starch is a natural polymer, a long chain of glucose units: an example.

clue.text: Saying name for dog possibly in lead

indicators.note: the dog's name sits inside the symbol

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
Rover is a classic dog's name

explanation.surface: Advice about naming a dog on its leash.
explanation.definitionFit: A proverb is a traditional saying or maxim.

clue.text: Is circumventing less than one of the charged particles

indicators.note: the letters of is go round the shortened word
the word one is cut short, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: Physics notes on a fractional particle count.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less than' here means a little short of the full word, so its final letter goes before 'circumventing' wraps the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Atoms or molecules carrying an electric charge.

clue.text: Drunk back at the bus garage

parts.note: toped is an old word for drank heavily

explanation.surface: A tipsy driver returns to the yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is where buses are kept and serviced.

clue.text: Moving right away for wine

indicators.note: the right goes away, so it is removed

parts.note: astir means up and moving

explanation.surface: Someone walks off to fetch a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian sparkling wine from Piedmont.

clue.text: At first in summer styles

indicators.note: the letters sit inside summer styles, across the word break

explanation.surface: A fashion note about the start of summer.
explanation.definitionFit: Erst is an archaic word meaning formerly or originally.

clue.text: Still no wind for many in the river

indicators.note: the numeral goes inside the river's name

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
L is the Roman numeral fifty, used for many

explanation.surface: A becalmed boat on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Still air with no breeze is the meteorological word for windless weather.

clue.text: Run down valley?

definitions.meaning: economically struggling, as a region in decline
a valley is literally ground pressed lower

explanation.definitionFit: A region in economic decline, and literally a sunken stretch of land such as a valley.

clue.text: Explosive device easily sniffed out?

parts.note: bomb squads use sniffer dogs, but this joke device would be detected by anyone's nose

explanation.surface: Security dogs detecting a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: A prank capsule that releases a foul smell when broken.
